_comment: Example shape for a private production question file.
This file is illustrative only. The numbers below are obviously fake and the
'answers' here are deliberately trivial, so nothing real is published by
A real file is created by an administrator on their own device, chosen through
the Admin import screen, and sent straight to the server. It is never written
to browser storage, never cached by the service worker and never logged.
The server splits every item: prompt and options go to 'questions', while
correctAnswer, solution, shortSolution, explanation and commonMistakes go to
the protected 'questionSolutions' collection that no learner can read.
Every imported item is stored as pending-review. A named human must approve it
